exposure: Implementation of a 'colour code' protocol for emergency cesareans
implementation of a 'colour code' protocol for emergency caesareans
Degree of emergency (code orange or code red)
cohort: Pregnant women undergoing emergency cesarean delivery at 26 maternity units in France
finding: Implementation of a 'colour code' protocol for emergency cesareans was associated with a significantly shorter DDI, but there was no difference in neonatal outcome.
